name: Strong Female Character — Fern Brady
description: Memoir by autistic Scottish comedian Fern Brady reflecting on her life, late autism diagnosis, masking, institutions, relationships and self-understanding.
intended_use: Inspect one autistic adult's memoir and perspective, especially around late recognition and masking.
audience_or_context: Readers seeking autistic lived experience and memoir rather than clinical guidance.
limitations: A memoir is one person's experience and should not be generalised to all autistic people.
It is not diagnostic or clinical guidance and includes difficult personal material that may not suit every reader.
cost_or_access_notes: Commercial book in multiple formats; prices and availability vary.
conflicts_of_interest: The author and publisher sell the book; ND Oracle uses it as a lived-experience/media route, not independent clinical evidence.

provenance.method: Current first-party identity, access route and stated function checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records what the resource is and how to reach it without adopting provider claims of benefit.
